title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
description: Binary search for a target in a rotated sorted array.

data.text: Given a rotated sorted array and a target value, return the index of the target or -1 if not found. O(log n) time required.
Scan for the target. O(n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Linear Scan O(n)

data.text: At each step determine which half is sorted, then decide which half contains the target. O(log n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Binary Search O(log n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n) → O(log n). **Space:** O(1). One half is always sorted — use that half to decide where the target must lie.

cards.title: Modified Binary Search
cards.description: Identify the sorted half, recurse there
